test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person goes from P to Q in 8 hours. He starts from P at 8 a.m. Another person goes from Q to P in 12 hours. He starts from Q at 9 a.m. At what time will they meet?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The LCM of 8 and 12 is 24 which can be assumed as the total distance between P and Q.

Speed of first person = 24/8 = 3 km/h

Speed of first-person = 24/12 = 2 km/h

First person started one hour earlier than the second person. So the distance covered by the first person in that first hour is 3 km.

Remaining distance = 24 - 3 = 21

Time taken by both of them to meet each other = 21/(3+2) = 21/ 5 = 4.2 hr

So the time when they will meet each other = 9 + 4.2 

9 hr + 4 hr + 12 minutes

1 ∶ 12 p.m.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
